'''Red Squadron''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] operating in the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CDD" />

==History==
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Battle of Death Star III|engaged]]<ref name="ST" /> the forces of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Ennix Devian]], which had launched a feint at the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], deploying what seemed to be a [[Death Star III|third Death Star]]&mdash;in reality an unfinished [[worldcraft]] habitation sphere<ref name="ImpWar">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>&mdash;and a force of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]] and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]].<ref name="ST" />

During the battle,<ref name="ST" /> the [[Red Leader (Star Tours)|pilot]] designated [[Red Leader/Legends|"Red Leader"]]<ref name="ILM book" /> discovered, to his surprise, that a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency [[StarSpeeder 3000]] had been caught in a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. Freeing the civilian vessel and attempting to protect it from a wave of TIE fighters, the pilots made for the Death Star's surface. Calling on squadronmates designated "[[Red Twenty-Four]]" and "[[Red Thirty]]" to provide cover for an attack run<ref name="ST" /> on the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] vulnerable [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]], a Red squadron X-wing<ref name="CDD" />&mdash;with [[Star Tours Flight 45]] close behind&mdash;scored a direct hit, destroying the station as the group jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="ST" />
